name: io.github.lycorp-jp/awx-mcp
title: AWX MCP Server
description: Manage AWX and Ansible Tower automation through MCP with per-user authentication and read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: ANSIBLE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: AWX base URL, for example https://awx.example.com/

environmentVariables.name: ANSIBLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: AWX personal access token. AWX permissions apply to every tool call.

environmentVariables.name: ANSIBLE_SSL_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Verify the AWX server TLS certificate.

environmentVariables.name: ANSIBLE_CA_BUNDLE
environmentVariables.description: CA bundle path inside the container. Mount the file when using a private CA.

environmentVariables.name: AWX_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool modules, for example jobs,job_templates. Use all for every toolset.
